pages.text: When the moon is full, the four Clans meet in peace on the island in the lake. Leaders share news from their territories, and old friends from different Clans may share tongues.
pages.title: The Full-Moon Truce

pages.text: During a Gathering there is no fighting. Ever. If clouds cover the moon, it is a sign that StarClan is angry. $(br2)Look up on a clear night. Every star you see is a warrior watching over you.

pages.title: Quiet Paws
pages.text: Don't want to be called away? Press the $(l)Quiet paws$() bookmark under your journal. No calls to meetings, no Moonpool dreams, and no surprise visitors, border patrols or hard choices out in the land.$(br2)Press it again whenever you like.
